body.statement: For rational polygonal input, rational piecewise-constant cell densities, rational piecewise-affine boundary weights, rational \(M_d\), rational \(m_d\) with \(r_d(m_d)>0\), and rational \(\epsilon>0\), can \(\mathsf{VPA}\) be completed and proved to terminate with an exactly moment-feasible continuous piecewise-affine primal surface and rational outward lower and upper enclosures of both arm endpoints whose gaps are at most \(\epsilon\)? The required certificate must verify exact continuous cell integrals, every clipping inequality, every Euclidean gradient inequality, and the continuous dual remainder rather than accept floating residuals.
body.justification: This is the nonroutine bridge from asymptotic mathematical convergence to a terminating auditable endpoint certificate.
body.gap: Mula and Nouy stop at convergent moments and approximate post-processing; Baldi and Mourrain's exact extraction requires flat truncation and zero-dimensional geometry, which need not hold for Lipschitz optimizer faces.
body.consumer: A successful routine would turn a Dell-style sign conclusion into a reproducible certificate whose validity does not depend on solver tolerances.
